sloka: अनृशम्सेन रामेण मोक्षिता राक्षसाः सरे ।वानरैर् अर्दितास् ते तु विक्रान्तैर् लघु विक्रमैः ॥६-२९-२९॥।।
transliteration: anṛśamsena rāmeṇa mokṣitā rākṣasāḥ sare ।vānarair arditās te tu vikrāntair laghu vikramaiḥ ॥6-29-29॥।।

translations.english: Harassed by the valorous and swift Vanaras, those Rakshasas lost their senses and returned to Lanka gasping and panting.
